texts: good. a fireable rule with the wraith, the lit lantern, the draining and the lantern as the source it is drained from all carried, and one draining derived per wraith-and-lantern pair.
good. the 'whenever' phrasing lands on the same fireable rule; 'nears' and 'pulls' are kept as written, and 'the wraith' and 'the lantern' correctly refer back to the ones named in the condition.
good. 'drained' becomes a condition on the rule rather than being folded into the noun, so it fires only for drained lanterns, and 'dimly' is kept as the stated manner of burning.
